name: Open Book
description: Not a published list: Hyoubu Institute's deck, built in Downfall Stage 7 so the sweeps reach a reveal heard as a moment and the Runner's draw parked ahead of The Class Act's look. Every card in it reveals or makes the Runner pay for what is revealed: the identity's click shows a grip card or the top of the stack and pays 1[credit] the first time each turn, Engram Flush and Bring Them Home reveal the grip, Public Health Portal the top of R&D, Snare! itself as it is accessed; Saisentan's net damage names a card type and does more for each card of it trashed, Letheia Nisei sends a Runner who loses its psi game back to the outermost ice, and Project Yagi-Uda banks its extra advancements to swap a card from HQ into the server being run. Of Jinteki and neutral cards, on Permafrost's and Second Site's frames, whose Core Set cards keep it out of Standard.
